titulo: South Korea’s financial industry hit by fresh wave of cyberattacks
resumo_original: South Korea’s financial institutions have been hit by another wave of cyberattacks, highlighting the growing risk of AI-driven hacking in Asia.

titulo: Voice AI in vogue: Nvidia releases new open transcription model
resumo_original: Nvidia just released a free speech-to-text model that can transcribe up to 40 languages, but it only works on recordings, not live audio, so it’s a big step for meeting and medical transcription tools while still leaving real-time use to rivals like ElevenLabs.

titulo: Amazon debuts the Alexa Photo Frame and Echo Time smart clock, plus other upgraded devices
resumo_original: Amazon's other new devices include an upgraded Echo Dot, an Echo Studio with visual intelligence features, and the Echo Show 16.

titulo: TikTok expands into restaurant guides with ‘Must Eat’ feature
resumo_original: The move puts TikTok in more direct competition with platforms like Yelp and Google.

titulo: Meta has a new AI pet app called Waddle World
resumo_original: Meta has launched a new app called Waddle World, which essentially looks like a Tamagotchi clone, but with AI.

titulo: A hidden ocean change near Antarctica could have global consequences
resumo_original: Antarctic waters are getting saltier as sea-ice loss reshapes ocean circulation.

titulo: China’s snooping around Pacific undersea cables raises risks for Big Tech
resumo_original: US-owned trans-Pacific cables face growing risks from sabotage and China.

titulo: Apple refreshes the iMac, entry-level MacBook Pro with the M6 chip
resumo_original: Additionally, the N1 chip brings Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6.
